summary: When {person} asks who pays for free rides, the treasurer opens the city's reimbursement agreement.
realLife: Boston used federal recovery funds to reimburse the MBTA for running its fare-free bus program.
gates: A funding record identifies the payer, operator and authorized service period.
inGame: needs: a funding record identifies the payer, operator and authorized service period.

turns.pulledBy: The agreement covers the requested period.
turns.what: Give the operator the covered dates.

turns.pulledBy: The requested period extends past the agreement.
turns.what: Take the extension back to the funding body.
